preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 2500.
The length of each string n must be between 2 and 5000.
The total length of all strings must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must be a valid string s or -1 if no such string exists.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) == n for s_i in strings)
postconditions.description: Each string in the input must have the same length n.

postconditions.expression: all(s_i in strings for s_i in strings)
postconditions.description: All strings must be present in the input.
